AGENDA
  CITY COUNCIL
  FEBRUARY 2, 2021

UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF
ASSEMBLY BILL 361, WHICH ALLOWS COUNCIL MEMBERS TO PARTICIPATE FROM A REMOTE LOCATION
WITHOUT LISTING A PHYSICAL LOCATION. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS DURING A MEETING: YOU MAY
ATTEND THE MEETING, SEND AN EMAIL TO: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, OR JOIN THE ZOOM
MEETING BY CALLING: (669) 900-6833 OR USING THE ZOOM APP WITH THE FOLLOWING LINK:
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/7095732685; MEETING ID: 709 573 2685. THE MEETING MAY BE VIEWED
THROUGH ZOOM, FIOS CHANNEL 32 OR CHARTER CHANNEL 3, OR ON THE CITY'S WEBPAGE AT:
https://www.norwalk.org/city-hall/meeting-agendas-393.

  REGULAR MEETING
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  6:00 P.M.

  Ana Valencia, Mayor
  Margarita L. Rios, Vice Mayor
  Tony Ayala, Councilmember
  Jennifer Perez, Councilmember
  Rick Ramirez, Councilmember

Public Comment: The public is encouraged to address City Council on any matter listed on the agenda or on any other matter within
its jurisdiction subject to the rules of decorum described in Section 2.08.020 of the Norwalk Municipal Code. If you wish to address City
Council, please complete the card that is provided at the rear entrance to Council Chambers and hand the card to the Sergeant at
Arms. City Council will hear public comment on items listed on the agenda during discussion of the matter and prior to a vote. City
Council will hear public comment on matters not listed on the agenda during the Oral Communications period.

Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless certain
emergency or special circumstances exist. The City Council may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain matters for
consideration at a future City Council meeting.

Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the City Council:
   Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
   Comments should be directed to the City Council as a whole and not directed to individual Councilmembers.

Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other
services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk’s department, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening devices are available at this
meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be
made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability. Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or
time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility
to the meeting or service.

Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it has been posted will also
be made available for public inspection.

Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk’s Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard during regular business
hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday – Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday; telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact
the City Clerk via e-mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

1. MEETING MINUTES – Staff recommends City Council approve the minutes of the meetings of
January 13 and 19, 2021.825-04

2. PAYROLL – Staff recommends City Council approve the payroll for the period December 27,
2020 – January 9, 2021, in the total amount of $886,174.86.630

3. COMMERCIAL DEMANDS – Staff recommends City Council approve the warrant register

4. PROJECT NO. 7858 – ACCEPT WORK - CITY HALL REMODEL PROJECT FOR COMMUNITY
DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT AND ENGINEERING DIVISON - Staff recommends City Council

room, in the amount of $340,896.30; and authorize the City Manager to sign the Certificate of

on the various City advisory bodies.200

6. ORDINANCE NO. 21-1722 - NORWALK MUNICIPAL CODE RECODIFICATION – Staff
recommends City Council accept for second reading and adopt Ordinance No. 21-1722, AN
ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF NORWALK, CALIFORNIA ADOPTING BY REFERENCE THE
NORWALK MUNICIPAL CODE, (WHICH CODE CONSISTS OF TITLES 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 12,
13, 15, 16, 17, AND 18 OF THE NORWALK MUNICIPAL CODE ON FILE IN THE OFFICE OF THE
NORWALK CITY CLERK), WHICH CODE ADOPTS THE FOLLOWING SECONDARY CODES BY
REFERENCE: DIVISION 1, HEALTH CODE, OF TITLE 11 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE;
DIVISION 1, PUBLIC HEALTH LICENSES, OF TITLE 8 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE;
THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY VEHICLES AND TRAFFIC CODE (THE COUNTY TRAFFIC
ORDINANCE) AS ADOPTED, AMENDED AND IN EFFECT ON FEBRUARY 13, 1981; THE LOS
ANGELES COUNTY CODE, TITLE 32, 2002 FIRE CODE; DIVISION 2, SANITARY SEWERS AND
INDUSTRIAL WASTE, OF TITLE 20 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE; PART 2 OF TITLE
24 OF THE CALIFORNIA CODE OF REGULATIONS, INCLUDING THE APPENDICES,
COMPRISING THE 2019 CALIFORNIA BUILDING CODE; PART 5 OF TITLE 24 OF THE
CALIFORNIA CODE OF REGULATIONS, INCLUDING THE APPENDICES, COMPRISING THE 2019
CALIFORNIA PLUMBING CODE; PART 3 OF TITLE 24 OF THE CALIFORNIA CODE OF
REGULATIONS, INCLUDING THE APPENDICES COMPRISING THE 2019 CALIFORNIA
ELECTRICAL CODE; PART 4 OF TITLE 24 OF THE CALIFORNIA CODE OF REGULATIONS,
INCLUDING THE APPENDICES, COMPRISING THE 2019 CALIFORNIA MECHANICAL CODE;
AND PART 10 OF TITLE 24 OF THE CALIFORNIA CODE OF REGULATIONS, COMPRISING
APPENDIX 1 OF THE 2019 CALIFORNIA CODE FOR BUILDING CONSERVATION.860

REPORTS

7. PROJECT NO. 7235 - AGREEMENT AMENDMENT NO. 1 – DESIGN SERVICES - RESOLUTION
NO. 21-03 – BUDGET AMENDMENT - Staff recommends City Council:

  a. adopt Resolution No. 21-03, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK AUTHORIZING AN
  AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2020/21 ADOPTED BUDGET
  TO APPROPRIATE AVAILABLE PROPOSITION C FUNDS TO
  PROJECT NO. 7235 – IMPERIAL HIGHWAY INTELLIGENT
  TRANSPORTATION SYSTEM (ITS) IMPROVEMENTS, in the
  amount of $166,000; and

  b. approve Amendment No. 1 to the agreement with Advantec Consulting
  Engineers to provide additional design services and additional
  compensation in the amount of $157,180; and authorize the City
  Manager to execute the amendment, and any additional amendments
  provided there is funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in a form
  approved by the City Attorney.1005-04-7235

 8. AMENDMENT NO. 2 TO THE CRISIS COMMUNICATION SERVICES AGREEMENT – Staff
recommends City Council approve Amendment No. 2 to the crisis communication consulting
services agreement with Merino, Barajas & Associates, Inc. extending the term through June
30, 2021 in an amount not to exceed $47,500; and authorize the City Manager to execute
Amendment No. 2 on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney. 710-07

9. AGREEMENT - ADVANCED RESERVATION DIAL-A-RIDE / SUBSCRIPTION SERVICE - Staff
recommends City Council approve the agreement with First Transit, Inc. in an amount of
$1,329,125 for the Advanced Reservation Dial-A-Ride / Subscription Service program for the
period of April 1, 2021 through June 30, 2023, with an option to extend annually for two (2)
additional one (1) year periods from July 1 through June 30 of each year thereafter for a total
contract value of $2,598,492; and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement and any
amendments, provided there is funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in a form approved
by the City Attorney. 1120-07

10. EMERGENCY AGREEMENT – PARATRANSIT USER SIDE SUBSIDY TRANSPORTATION
PROGRAM - Staff recommends City Council approve by a 4/5 vote, the emergency contract
between the City of Norwalk and First Transit, Inc. in partnership with Lyft to provide
Paratransit User Side Subsidy Transportation services, for a period of six months; effective,
March 1, 2021 through August 31, 2021, in the amount of $32,502; and authorize the City
Manager to execute the agreement and any amendments provided there is funding in the
budget, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney. 1120-07

11. SIXTH (6th) CYCLE HOUSING ELEMENT UPDATE - Staff recommends City Council receive
and file this report.

12. CORONAVIRUS PANDEMIC – FEBRUARY EMERGENCY OPERATIONS CENTER UPDATE –
Receive and file. 710-07

ADJOURNMENT
